text: The Ministry of Environment AI-based Flood Forecasting and Early Warning System is a nationwide initiative in South Korea aimed at enhancing public safety through smart forecasting. It utilizes AI models to perform automated, 10-minute interval analyses of flood likelihood, issuing location-specific safety messages to residents and drivers, and alerting local governments, fire, and police for rapid response mobilization. The system expands real-time monitoring from 75 to 223 locations, integrating public-sector data with private navigation services for dynamic rerouting during heavy rain events.
